sents.zh: 两千五百多年以前，中国有一位老师。
sents.en: More than two thousand five hundred years ago, there was a teacher in China.

sents.zh: 那时候，只有很有钱的人才可以读书。
sents.en: In those days, only the wealthy could study.

sents.zh: 但是孔子说，谁想学，他就教谁。
sents.en: But Confucius said he would teach anyone who wanted to learn.

sents.zh: 所以他的学生越来越多。
sents.en: So his students grew more and more numerous.

sents.zh: 他的学生里有大人，也有很年轻的人。
sents.en: Among his students were grown men and very young people.

sents.zh: 他们一起读书，一起说话，一起走路。
sents.en: They read together, talked together and walked together.

sents.zh: 孔子常常说：“学了以后要常常想一想。”
sents.en: Confucius often said: "After you learn, think it over often."

sents.zh: 他也说：“不知道的事情，问一问就好。”
sents.en: He also said: "If you do not know a thing, simply ask."

sents.zh: 有学生问他：“什么是好人？”
sents.en: A student asked him: "What is a good person?"

sents.zh: 他说：“自己不想要的，就不要给别人。”
sents.en: He said: "Do not give others what you would not want yourself."

sents.zh: 虽然他一直想做官，但是没有成功。
sents.en: Although he long wanted to serve as an official, he did not succeed.

sents.zh: 所以他把时间都用在教学生上面。
sents.en: So he put all his time into teaching.

sents.zh: 他走了以后，学生把他说过的话写了下来。
sents.en: After he died, his students wrote down what he had said.

sents.zh: 因为有这本书，所以今天我们还知道他的想法。
sents.en: Because of that book, we still know his thinking today.
